title: Syrian Fried Pudding Fritters
description: A sweet and crispy dessert featuring fried pudding fritters inspired by Syrian cuisine. These bite-sized treats are perfect for snacking.
instructions: In a large bowl, combine crumbled black pudding and beaten eggs. Mix until well combined.
Add confectioners sugar, vanilla extract, and all-purpose flour to the bowl. Mix until a thick batter forms.
Heat 2 inches of vegetable oil in a frying pan over medium heat.
Using a spoon, drop small balls of the pudding batter into the hot oil.
Fry fritters until golden brown, about 2-3 minutes per side.
Using a slotted spoon, remove fritters from the oil and place on a paper towel-lined plate to drain excess oil.
Dust the fritters with powdered sugar and serve immediately.
